rules.rule: Every Convex query and mutation that reads or writes tenant-owned data must enforce tenant isolation using server-derived identity and tenant scope. Platform-wide cross-tenant functions require their explicit platform sub-role gate.
The first action in every Convex function must enforce its authorization check before reading data or performing side effects.
Every role and operation cell not explicitly granted by PLATFORM_SUB_ROLE_MAP is denied. Never infer or broaden a permission from a similar role.
Never expose secret values or environment values in source, logs, API responses, UI, docs, tests, or review artifacts.
User-facing output must not expose technology stack, provider, implementation, or filesystem details. Route every failure through the shared safe error translation boundary.
Do not add mock, placeholder, sample, fabricated, or hardcoded business data. Use verified persisted data and show unavailable values explicitly.
Every mutation must write an audit entry that records actor, action, and affected entity while excluding credentials and sensitive payloads.
Never weaken mandatory MFA or session rules: 30-minute inactivity timeout, warning at 25 minutes, and 12-hour absolute lifetime.
Do not add a runtime dependency, service, provider, or infrastructure technology outside docs/technology-stack.md. Greptile review files are tooling and not runtime dependencies.
